statement: I have reviewed the prior-exposure log and the complete machine-readable specification inventory through the stated cutoff. I attest that no factor IC, forward-return, portfolio-return, signal ranking, variant ranking, test-statistic outcome, or registered publication-exposure diagnostic value for the fixed 2010-2022 Stage-2 panel has been computed, released to the research team, or human-inspected through attested_at. Automated custodial validators may have parsed numeric bytes solely to check schema, finiteness, dates, identifiers, exact endpoint presence, and permitted aggregate coverage; they did not emit or retain the prohibited research outcomes. I understand that known pilot exposure and unknown historical execution status remain disclosed. If this statement cannot be made truthfully, the plan core must not be frozen and the study must stop.
